serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.face.normal
You: Hi, Annalie. What’s up?
Lady Annalie: Oh, hi! How can I help you? We can try some things if you want~
You: Actually, I wanted to ask you something about the island.
#Annalie.face.sad
Lady Annalie: This again? 
#Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.surprised
Lady Annalie: Ugh…{{wi}} The rich guy is getting quite shameless…
#Annalie.face.sad
You: “Rich guy”? Really? Is that my new nickname?
Lady Annalie: It’s more of a slur than anything, really.
Wow. She’s so bitter.
You: Would spending some money here make your mood better?
Lady Annalie: I don’t know. You can try and see what happens.
Her customer service sucks. She’s never gonna make it with that attitude…
I should just buy something to get it over with.
